title: Desk Guidance on Refunds of Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Charges
content:
**Clause 1.** Refunds of Wayfare Bikes and Scooters charges return to the original payment method and name the charge refunded.

**Clause 2.** A ride is refunded in full for a malfunction reported within the plan's malfunction reporting window after the ride ended; overtime caused by a dock that failed to lock the vehicle is refunded where the plan's refund terms provide for dock-failure refunds; a lost vehicle fee is refunded in full when the vehicle is recovered undamaged within the plan's recovery window of the unlock; a duplicate charge is always refunded.

**Clause 3.** Support refunds only charges within the plan's ride history window.

**Clause 4.** A charge is refunded once. Before a refund is made, the company's charge records are checked for a refund already naming that charge; where one exists, the charge is not refunded again.

## Bases of refund

| Refund reason recorded | What is refunded | Time condition | Counted from |
|---|---|---|---|
| vehicle malfunction | the ride, in full | malfunction reported within the reporting window, in elapsed hours | the end of the ride |
| dock failure | the overtime caused by a dock that failed to lock the vehicle | none stated | — |
| lost vehicle recovered | the lost vehicle fee, in full, if the vehicle is recovered undamaged | recovery within the recovery window, in calendar days | the unlock |
| duplicate charge | the duplicate charge | none stated; always refunded | — |

Each refund is booked as one entry per charge refunded: a negative amount returned, dated the day of the refund, naming the original charge and carrying one of the four reasons above.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

Taking, for illustration, a reporting window of 48 hours and a recovery window of 7 calendar days:

- A ride ended at 18:00 on a Friday; the malfunction is reported at 12:00 on the Saturday, 18 elapsed hours later. The report is within the window and the ride is refunded in full.
- The same malfunction reported at 09:00 on the following Monday, 63 elapsed hours after the ride ended, is outside the window; the malfunction basis does not apply.
- An e-bike unlocked on 3 May and charged as lost is recovered undamaged on 6 May, within 7 calendar days of the unlock: the lost vehicle fee is refunded in full.
- The same e-bike recovered undamaged on 20 May is outside the window; the recovery basis does not apply.
- A ride charge that already has a refund entry naming it is not refunded a second time.
